initial_requirements: KeePass Password Safe is intended to help users manage many passwords without repeatedly reusing or memorizing them. It should store passwords, usernames, email accounts, URLs, and related notes in an encrypted database protected by a master credential. Users also need a practical way to organize and use the stored entries while keeping the database portable between computers.
